title: Read the smart-pointer Makefile
description: A Makefile defines targets and the recipes that build them. You can follow this file's build, run, and cleanup targets.

steps.description: The variables select g++, C++17, warnings, debug information, and AddressSanitizer. They also name the source and binary.
The default target depends on smartptr.cpp. Its recipe invokes the compiler with the declared variables.
The run target depends on the binary. Its recipe launches that binary after any needed build.
The clean recipe removes the binary. .PHONY marks run and clean as command targets.
